digest.title: OpenCode Console Breach May Have Exposed OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API Keys
digest.tldr: An intruder reached a legacy system at OpenCode on the night of October 16 and may have exposed the third-party AI provider keys that users had saved in OpenCode Console, the company said.

digest.title: Microsoft: October Windows Server updates break Exchange sign-in, mail flow
digest.tldr: Microsoft has confirmed that this month's Windows Server security updates are causing OWA sign-in and mail delivery issues on some Exchange Server systems.
